notes.title: Serbian Games Week: Discounts, New Bundle and Our Next Game!
notes.content:
We’re part of Serbian Games Week! Discover awesome games at a discount all week long.
https://store.steampowered.com/sale/SerbianGamesWeek2025
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36651033/0630317b984b6d579c175b20629a1fc09b898313.png


Serbian Games Week
Serbian Games Week - over 120 titles on the Steam sale event featuring Serbian games

From Monday, September 22, gamers around the world will have the opportunity to browse, buy, or wishlist games made in Serbia. Some of over 120 games will be heavily discounted, while others will soon be published.

The Serbian Games Association (SGA) has curated and launched Serbian Games Week, seven days of promotion and celebration of the success of the Serbian gaming ecosystem on Steam. 

There are more than 120 games on the list. It includes a wide variety of titles: from action, strategy and adventure, AA and indie projects, to games inspired by Slavic mythology. The search for the perfect game is made easier through categories and filters by genre.

Five games were singled out in the Epic Experiences category. The King is Watching, a new title from the publisher tinyBuild, is a roguelite kingdom-building game in which the player rules with the power of their gaze. Going Medieval, by the indie team Foxy Voxel, is a cozy city builder simulator with, as the word itself suggests, a medieval theme. DerailValley is the title of the studio Altfuture, a train driving simulator through beautiful, but also challenging landscapes. Entertainment Forge is behind Gladiator Guild Manager, a strategic autobattle simulation of gladiators fighting. Fifth in this section is Tavern Master by Untitled Studio, another simulation set in the Middle Ages, but in this one, you build your perfect inn.

Serbian Games Week will last from September 22nd to 29th.


Our Next Game
Don’t forget to wishlist and follow our newest title, Dreadwoods Gatekeeper! A complete visual overhaul and demo are coming soon.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2389020/Dreadwoods_Gatekeeper/

Thank you all for your support!
